speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Isn't she brilliant, Leonard? How I envy you.

speaker: dr_beverly_hofstadter
text: So, Howard, have you and Rajesh finally summoned the courage to express your latent homosexual feelings toward one another?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Because we don't have latent homosexual feelings toward one another.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: No, really. I have a girlfriend now.

speaker: dr_beverly_hofstadter
text: And where is she this evening?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: She had to go out of town. Her grandmother died.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Honest to God. Leonard, tell her I have a girlfriend.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I don't know what you're talking about.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: What do you mean you don't know what I'm talking about? Tell her I have a girlfriend!

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: All right. He" has" a" girlfriend."

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Her name is Bernadette, she's working as a waitress, but she's going to school to be a microbiologist.

speaker: dr_beverly_hofstadter
text: Howard, keep in mind that the more passionately you stick to this construct, the more you're hurting your partner.
